file_name: Alcoa - South32 aluminium assets - third-party questionnaire - 10 September 2026_0.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Alcoa and South32 are close competitors in the supply of bauxite, smelter grade alumina and primary aluminium, and identify alternative suppliers, or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Alcoa and/or South32.
